inbox.title: Inbox

needsYou.title: Nothing needs you.
needsYou.body: Anything unclear will show up here.

ready.title: Nothing waiting to be sent.
ready.body: Drafts you ask for appear here. You always press send yourself.

firstRun.title: Capture once, confirm once.
firstRun.body: Send things to your inbox in any of these ways. Each one is switched on by you.

offline.banner: You're offline. Captures are saved on this device and will process when you're back.
offline.decisions: Decisions need the server. Reconnect to confirm, edit or dismiss.
offline.badge: Offline, will process when you're back

card.readNextDate: We read {date} in the order, page {page}. Set as the next date?
card.read: We read this in the source. Confirm it?
card.sensitive: Sensitive matter. Details are hidden here.
card.failed: Couldn't save that. Nothing changed. Try again.
card.stale: This was already resolved. The inbox has been refreshed.

conflict.title: Two sources disagree about the next date
conflict.oneProceeding: This changes the date for this proceeding only.

unreadable.title: Couldn't read this
unreadable.copy: Couldn't read this. Retake, type the key line, or keep as an attachment.
unreadable.saved: Saved. We will read what you typed.
unreadable.unrecognisedSenderCopy: This email came from a sender you have not allowed, so nothing in it was read. Review it, then add the sender to your allow-list if you trust it.

reassign.explain: This moves the documents, tasks and obligations made from this capture to the matter you pick. Available until {date}.

toast.undone: Undone. The card is back in your inbox.
toast.undoFailed: Couldn't undo that. It may be older than 7 days.

announce.confirmedNextDate: Proposal confirmed. Next date set to {date}.
announce.newItems: {count, plural, one {# new item needs you} other {# new items need you}}

preview.title: Source
preview.empty: Select an item to see where it came from.
preview.noSource: No source quote for this item.

inbox.readOnly: View only. You can read this item but not act on it.
inbox.denied: You do not have access to this. Ask the workspace owner.

shortcuts.title: Inbox shortcuts
shortcuts.description: Shortcuts are ignored while you are typing in a field.
shortcuts.undo: Undo the last item (while the toast shows)

sourceChip.khcList: Fetched from the KHC public list at {time}
